text: FastAPI + Async: The 2026 AI API Pattern
code:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from anthropic import AsyncAnthropic

app, ai = FastAPI(), AsyncAnthropic()

@app.post('/ask')
async def ask(q: str) -> dict:
    r = await ai.messages.create(
        model='claude-sonnet-4-6', max_tokens=256,
        messages=[{'role':'user','content':q}])
    return {'answer': r.content[0].text}
subtext: Always use async LLM clients. Blocking a worker thread under load costs you concurrency. AsyncAnthropic and AsyncOpenAI are drop-in replacements.

PySpark 2026: Ditch Raw Parquet for Delta
code:
# Raw Parquet: no ACID, no time travel
df.write.parquet('s3://bucket/raw/')

# Delta Lake: ACID + schema evolution
(df.write
   .format('delta')
   .option('mergeSchema', 'true')
   .mode('overwrite')
   .save('s3://bucket/delta/events'))
subtext: Raw Parquet has zero ACID guarantees. Delta Lake and Iceberg give you time travel, schema evolution, and concurrent writes — for free.
